title: New York Jets News: David Bailey suffers an ankle injury at training camp practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: New York Jets News: David Bailey suffers an ankle injury at training camp practice
sources.description: Happy Sunday, Jets fan! Injuries continue to be one of the key stories of the early stages of Jets training camp. At Saturday’s practice, number two overall pick David Bailey hobbled off the field with an ankle injury. The good news is that the injury is minor, and Bailey is not expected to miss much […]
